bio.text: Hillary Herzig is the Republican candidate for New Jersey's 6th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, challenging Democratic Rep. Frank Pallone.
The New Jersey Globe described her in November 2025 as an Oceanport resident and a first-time candidate.

The Globe reported that, according to her campaign website, she is a mother of three, a military spouse and a civil servant who has worked for the Key West Chief of Police, the U.S. Army Intelligence and Security Operations, and U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services.

sources.title: Republican newcomer enters race against Pallone in NJ-6
